## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (both adapters for adapter changes)
- [ ] `pnpm build`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm format:check` pass locally
- [ ] Accessibility checked (keyboard path, screen-reader names, contrast) for UI changes
- [ ] Changeset added (`pnpm changeset`) for user-visible changes to a published package
- [ ] READMEs / demos updated if the public API or behaviour changed
